macros.name: AfterLastParam
macros.doc: \AfterLastParam is inserted at the end to begin a new line.

macros.name: arg
macros.doc: Formats an argument of a command without extra angle brackets in curled brackets in monospaced font.

macros.name: command
macros.doc: Prints the argument with backslash in typewriter font.

macros.name: Default
macros.doc: \Default is used to print out the default value of a command.

macros.name: environment
macros.doc: Formats an environment in typewriter font and adds it to the index.

macros.name: Example
macros.doc: \Example is used to print out an example for the usage of a command.

macros.name: file
macros.doc: Prints out the filename in typewriter font and links to the usage if an equivalent \labelfile is given.

macros.name: labelfile
macros.doc: Creates a label that is used by \file for linking to the occurrence of \labelfile.

macros.name: ltxclass
macros.doc: Formats a LaTeX class in typewriter font and adds it to the index.

macros.name: marg
macros.doc: Formats a mandatory argument of a command.

macros.name: oarg
macros.doc: Formats a optional argument of a command.

macros.name: option
macros.doc: Formats an option in typewriter font and adds it to the index.

macros.name: package
macros.doc: Prints out a package name as package.

macros.name: parameter
macros.doc: Formats a parameter in typewriter font.

macros.name: person
macros.doc: Print out name of a person, for example for the acknowledge of their help during the development of some code.

macros.name: printCodeFromFile
macros.doc: This command is very helpful to display parts of a file sequentially.
